title: Harnessing Image Question Dependence for Better VLM Test-time Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.13296v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning can adapt vision-language models (VLMs) to unlabeled target data, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by the reliability of self-generated learning signals. To assess the reliability of consensus-based learning signals, we analyze VLM test-time reinforcement learning across diverse VQA datasets and model sizes, revealing two limitations. First, gains from consensus-based test-time training largely come from answer normalization rather than content correction. Second, many initial VLM responses are incorrect due to the model's limited ability to jointly use the image and the question; consensus rewards derived from these outputs may preserve the resulting grounding errors rather than correct them. Motivated by these, we propose TTIQ, a test-time reinforcement learning framework that harnesses image-question dependence for better vlm adaptation. TTIQ teacher-forces each sampled response under t

translated_title: 利用图像-问题依赖性实现更好的视觉语言模型测试时强化学习
translated_abstract: 测试时强化学习可以将视觉语言模型（VLM）适配到无标注的目标数据上，但其有效性从根本上受限于自我生成学习信号的可靠性。为了评估基于共识的学习信号的可靠性，我们分析了跨多种VQA数据集和不同模型规模的VLM测试时强化学习，揭示了两个局限性。第一，基于共识的测试时训练所带来的收益很大程度上来自答案格式规范化而非内容纠错。第二，由于模型联合利用图像和问题的能力有限，许多初始VLM回答本身就是错误的；从这些输出中导出的共识奖励可能会保留由此产生的视觉定位错误，而不是纠正它们。基于这些发现，我们提出了TTIQ，一个利用图像-问题依赖性来实现更好VLM适配的测试时强化学习框架。TTIQ对每个采样的回答施加教师强制约束……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出TTIQ测试时强化学习框架，通过利用图像与问题之间的依赖关系生成更可靠的学习信号，解决了现有基于共识的奖励信号会保留而非纠正模型视觉定位错误的局限性。
